title: Bytebase
name: bytebase
description: Database change management for teams, where schema changes to Postgres, MySQL and plenty of others get planned, reviewed and rolled out with a full history, plus a web SQL editor. Source: https://github.com/bytebase/bytebase

env.name: BYTEBASE_DB_PASSWORD
env.label: Database password (required)
env.description: For Bytebase's own Postgres. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it the same when you redeploy.

env.name: BYTEBASE_PORT
env.label: Host port for the web UI

note: Set the database password before you deploy (openssl rand -hex 32), since the stack won't start without it. Then open http://<your-host>:8093 (or whichever port you picked) and create the first account, which becomes the workspace admin. Docs: docs.bytebase.com
